method: secrets.choice over three independently authored alternatives before candidate access

options.concept: After-hours records window continuously prints duplicate patient wristbands while the woman waits for her chart behind a locked pane.
A discharge waiting area returns the woman an empty records sleeve while the release door remains magnetically locked and the counter hatch is sealed.
A hospital archive places the woman at an observation glass, her chart trapped visibly on the staff side while the unmanned counter light signals that she is still being processed.
